# Basin Head Provincial Park

**Location:** Points East Coastal Drive

**Park Type:** Day Use Park

**Supervised Beach:** Yes

The Basin Head Day Park features a supervised beach, fisheries museum, on-site concessions and washroom. The beach is split into two sections, divided by a channel, known locally as “the run.” The pure white sand of the area is geologically unique. Because it actually "sings" when stepped on due to its high silica content, the beach is nicknamed "the Singing Sands".

A beach mat gives access to the water from the wharf and a floating wheelchair is available when surf conditions are safe.

- **Open June 5 to October 12, 2026**
- **Location:** 336 Basin Head Rd, Route 16, Kingsboro
- **Lifeguard service** available at this beach; days of the week and hours do vary. Check [Beach Reports](https://www.tourismpei.com/what-to-do/beaches-parks/beach-safety-reports "Beach Safety & Reports ") to see when a lifeguard(s) is on duty.

**LIFEGUARD NOT ON DUTY** at this time. When beaches are **UNSUPERVISED**, visitors swim at their **OWN RISK**.
